Grim Realism Comes to Horror Gaming in “RUE MORGUE #207 Jul/Aug 2022 Issue”

Horror gaming gets real in RUE MORGUE #207 Jul/Aug 2022 issue featuring an in-depth look at THE MORTUARY ASSISTANT, the upcoming game that is part mortuary science simulator, part haunted house playthrough, and sheer immersive terror. Also features a spotlight on the indie horror games of DREAD XP, Toronto-based studio Laundry Bear’s A MORTICIAN’S TALE and lots more!
